text:
Jakob Chychrun spent last weekend in the headlines for a hit, not a goal: RMNB and HockeyFeed both carried Nick Cousins's reaction, quoted as "I've never been hit that hard before". It was a reminder that the Capitals' offensive defenseman has an edge to him, and it landed in a rough week, the end of a stretch in which Washington lost six straight of his games.

The scoring is decent and a bit unlucky. He has 15 points in 21 games, seven on the power play, while shooting 4.6% against a likely 6 to 10%, and Washington has scored 4.9 fewer goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice. That kind of gap tends to close. His 65 shots on goal lead a lot of forwards.

Evolving-Hockey had him 23rd among defensemen last season and noted he was better than his goals then too, with 3.7 expected wins against 2.3 actual. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking put him 92nd percentile for chances from the slot. A defenseman who keeps getting there will get paid eventually.
